rules: Input candidate universe remains the 53 source genes meeting the frozen formal-response criteria; no human outcome or protein correlation informs mapping.
Recover the exact versioned mouse Ensembl gene ID from original GSE235046 count-table geneID; all 101 source candidate symbols map to exactly one protein-coding source row.
Trim the source ID version only when querying Ensembl release 116, retain the original versioned ID in all provenance records.
Accept only homology edges whose data.id AND homology.source.id equal the recovered source stable ID; discard additional symbol/alias query hits for other source stable IDs.
Primary current-ID human panel requires a unique Ensembl ortholog_one2one edge to Homo sapiens and a matched official HGNC protein-coding target stable ID/symbol; never infer a target by uppercasing.
Preserve each source up/down direction without using recipient-cohort outcomes; keep the inherited fixed48 as the historical comparator.

Where an approved symbol has changed, use the verified target stable ID as the join key; document cohort-specific symbol aliases from official HGNC fields rather than opportunistic expression matches.
Exclude no-Ensembl-human-ortholog or non-protein-coding targets from the primary RNA-protein panel; report their distinct statuses without treating server error as absence.
MGI homology classes provide independent cross-resource corroboration, not a substitute for an Ensembl one-to-one assertion.
Current annotation audit does not reconstruct the historical orthology database release or undocumented historical cache-generation code.

source53.excluded_reason: Ensembl116 returned an empty homology list; MGI human counterpart is HGNC-approved pseudogene, inappropriate for primary human protein score.
Successful source-stable-ID query returned empty human homologies and no matching mouse MGI homology group was found; do not infer a human target.
